meta.description: 480 Thumun (eighth-of-Hizb) boundaries of the Quran, Hafs numbering (ayahId 1..6236).
meta.numbering: Hafs; ayahId is sequential 1..6236 matching quran-uthmani.txt (Tanzil Uthmani).
meta.notes: start/end are inclusive. thumun_global runs 1..480 (unique key). hizb=ceil(thumun_global/8), juz=ceil(hizb/2), thumun_in_hizb=((thumun_global-1)%8)+1. end of a thumun is (start of next) - 1.
